security_findings.finding: Email/password enabled without delivery verification/recovery integration; suitable documented local workflow, not production identity completeness
API JWT lifetime is 5 minutes; frontend logout revokes session but does not immediately revoke already issued offline-verifiable API tokens
Forwarded IP headers disabled in local environment; shared throttle buckets protect against spoofing but trusted production ingress policy remains unresolved
Drafts reside in browser localStorage per problem/language. No automatic source upload; persistence is local best effort and not per-account encrypted storage
Pinned patched DOMPurify is substituted into locally bundled Monaco; no remote editor CDN or vendored stale sanitizer path accepted
Same-origin redirects and schema-validated bounded request behavior protect UI boundaries; safe messages avoid raw private diagnostics
No confirmed malicious web source or live credential discovered by targeted static review; no claim of compromise attribution or full vulnerability audit
